Replace spaces with underscores in column names

Source: R/data-prep.R
replace_spaces_with_underscores.Rd

Uses janitor::clean_names() to standardize column names.

Usage

replace_spaces_with_underscores(df)

Arguments

df

A data frame to process

Value

A data frame with cleaned column names

See also

Other data-prep: build_imp_column_names(), build_sat_column_names(), change_labeles_to_factors(), convert_labels_to_row_names(), prep_data(), remove_data_prefix(), remove_data_suffix()
